limitations: This is an assistant/vision-model review, not human review or user approval.
The reviewed images come from actual PPTX rendering, not HTML/SVG screenshots. Native PowerPoint and WPS applications were not opened or compared.
The six studies are authored fixtures that exercise the plugin renderer. No DSH model authoring session or model-quality evaluation was run.
Subject-matter data are constructed, not reported research. The confidence intervals illustrate assumptions rather than validate them.
Rebuilding changes the artifact identity and requires fresh rendering and image review. This record is not inherited by future outputs.
